A similar fate befell V-Varen Nagasaki, who returned to J2 after their inaugural season in the top tier.{{Cite web |url=https://www.v-varen.com/news/78055.html |title=11月21日 代表取締役社長 髙田明 J2降格に伴う会見のご報告 | V・ファーレン長崎 |access-date=2018-12-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181216210910/https://www.v-varen.com/news/78055.html |archive-date=2018-12-16 |url-status=dead }} Matsumoto Yamaga and Oita Trinita, having earned promotion, filled their vacancies, while Tokyo Verdy missed out on promotion after losing the play-off against Júbilo Iwata.
